Root cause = a boot RACE in Web/app.js: init() set State.booted=true BEFORE checking api(), and a 400ms setTimeout fallback raced pywebview's API injection. On a launch where pywebview took >400ms to inject window.pywebview.api, the timeout fired init() first -> booted=true + the hsl(i*5,70%,55%) rainbow fallback palette (70 vivid hues, NO white/grey/black); then 'pywebviewready' fired but init() early-returned (booted already true), so the real ABLETON_PALETTE (white=13, greys 13/27/41/55/69) never loaded. Intermittent by launch speed (why it "changed"). Fix: booted now locks ONLY on a real API-backed boot; a provisional fallback boot (previewBooted) can be UPGRADED when pywebviewready fires later; timeout 400->2500ms; init() re-renders the queue on the upgrade. NB Sam's BUILT projects were always correct (the engine writes the palette INDEX, and the profiles already map vocals=13/fx=55) — only the picker DISPLAY was the rainbow. node --check OK; needs Sam to relaunch + confirm the picker now shows the Ableton palette with white/grey.
